name: edit_file
description: Replace exact text in a file of your worktree: `old`, blanks and line breaks included, becomes `new`. The way to make a small change: read the file, copy the lines to change as `old`, write what they become as `new`. Line endings and trailing blanks are tolerated, leading whitespace is not. It changes nothing when `old` is not in the file (the error shows the closest region with line numbers) or is in it more than once without `replace_all` (the error lists the lines: add context). The path is relative to the worktree; not `.git`, not through a symlink; text of at most 1 MiB. A new or whole file: write_file; several files: apply_patch.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the root of the worktree

old.description: The text to replace, copied from the file (blanks and line breaks too). Must be in the file; and once, unless replace_all is set.

new.description: What it becomes. May be empty, to delete the text.

replace_all.description: Replace every place `old` is in. Leave out to replace the one place that has it.

repo.description: The slot to edit in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
